description: This file defines a Flutter widget for the Settings screen of a mobile application. It provides UI elements for changing streaming quality settings and toggling subtitles default behavior, integrating with a SettingsController.

classes.name: SettingsScreen
classes.description: A Flutter StatelessWidget that renders the settings UI for quality and subtitles options.

methods.name: build
methods.description: Constructs the widget tree for the settings screen, including app bar, list view with streaming quality options and subtitles toggle.
